subject: Copywriting
title: Clickbait: Headlines as Traps
description: One-minute skill: Clickbait: Headlines as Traps.

hook.text: 'You Won't Believe What Happened Next'—a headline formula that generated billions of clicks and ruined trust.

buildup.text: Upworthy and BuzzFeed proved curiosity gaps work. Withhold information and people click to fill the gap.

discovery.text: Clickbait exploits a psychological itch. Your brain can't tolerate incomplete patterns. You MUST click.

twist.text: Facebook and Google changed their algorithms to punish clickbait. The technique that worked too well got banned.

climax.text: Clickbait taught a lesson: short-term tricks destroy long-term trust. Headlines must deliver on their promise.

punchline.text: Clickbait got the click. Then lost the reader forever.

quiz.question: What psychological principle does clickbait exploit?
